build.toolchain: rust 1.95.0 (59807616e 2026-04-14), the upstream CI/release pin (RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN in .github/workflows)
build.native: cargo build --profile goport --locked -p ts_goport --bin tsgo --features noembed --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+crt-static -C relocation-model=static'; profile goport = release + lto=fat + codegen-units=1; no PGO (the release binary is PGO-trained and targets musl)
build.wasm.size: scripts/wasm/build.sh: cargo rustc --profile wasm (opt-level z, lto fat, codegen-units 1) -p ts_wasm --lib --target wasm32-wasip1 -- -C strip=debuginfo; wasm-opt 133 --flatten --rereloop -Oz -Oz + order-functions.mjs + wasm-opt -s 2 --reorder-functions-by-name --strip-debug --strip-producers
build.wasm.speed: as wasm.size with CARGO_PROFILE_WASM_OPT_LEVEL=s and RUSTFLAGS -C llvm-args=-inlinehint-threshold=150
build.wasm.features: rustc wasm32-wasip1 defaults only (see vendor/BUILD-INFO.txt); no simd128, no threads/atomics; wasm-opt --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals --enable-multivalue --enable-reference-types
